bugs_found: loan_payment does not validate months > 0, causing divide-by-zero for 0 and nonsensical payments for negative months
compound_interest silently truncates fractional years and compounds_per_year via int(), changing financial results without validation
loan_payment silently truncates fractional months via int(), changing repayment schedules without validation
transfer is non-atomic: source balance is debited before destination credit, so an exception during credit can leave inconsistent balances
transfer does not normalize/validate amount as Decimal/finite, so float or malformed amounts can raise unexpectedly or bypass intended money handling
apply_fee can return a negative net amount when fee_min exceeds amount, effectively charging more than the transaction amount
fx_convert does not validate exchange rate positivity/finite value, allowing negative, zero, NaN, or infinite rates to produce invalid converted amounts
